extracted text:
For Ge-poor ITH (Si/Ge = 13.3 according to chemical analysis), germanium oxide (GeO2, 99.99%, Aldrich) was first dissolved in a 1 m solution of HM dihydroxide followed by the addition of tetraethyl orthosilicate (TEOS, 98%, Aldrich). The mixture was stirred at room temperature until the water/ethanol mixture was evaporated. This resulted in a gel with the composition 0.90SiO2:0.09GeO2:0.25HM:5H2O. This was transferred into a Teflon-lined autoclave and heated at 175°C for 14 days with slow stirring (60 rpm).

Ge-rich ITH (Si/Ge = 2.3 according to chemical analysis) was crystallized using TMHDA as the structure-directing agent in the presence of fluorine anions according to Ren et al. The synthetic suspension with the composition 0.5SiO2:0.5GeO2:7TMHDA:1.4HF:44H2O was then heated at 175°C for 6 days under static conditions.

IWW samples were prepared using MPP dihydroxide as the SDA according to ref [6]. A gel composition of (1-x)SiO2:xGeO2:0.25MPP:10H2O was achieved, in which x = 0.33 for Ge-rich IWW (Si/Ge = 2.9 according to chemical analysis) and x = 0.2 for Ge-poor IWW (Si/Ge = 7.2 according to chemical analysis), respectively. The reaction mixture was then heated at 175°C for 7 days.

UTL samples were prepared according to ref. [22b] by the crystallization of a gel with the composition of (1-x)SiO2:xGeO2:0.25DMAD:30H2O at 175°C for 6 days under agitation (60 rpm), in which x = 0.33 for Ge-rich UTL (Si/Ge = 3.8 according to chemical analysis) and x = 0.17 for Ge-poor UTL (Si/Ge = 6.0 according to chemical analysis), respectively.
property mapping:
In the document text:
- SiO2 corresponds to Si
- GeO2 corresponds to Ge
- HM, TMHDA, MPP, DMAD correspond to osda_names
- H2O corresponds to H2O
- HF corresponds to HF
- Temperature in °C corresponds to crystallization_temperature
- Time in days corresponds to crystallization_time (needs to be converted to hours)
- ITH, IWW, UTL correspond to product_names
formula abbreviations:
- HM = hexamethonium
- TMHDA = NNN'N'-tetramethyl-1,6-hexanediamine
- MPP = 1,5-bis(methylpyrrolidinium)pentane
- DMAD = (6R,10S)-6,10-dimethyl-5-azoniaspiro[4,5]decane
- TEOS = tetraethyl orthosilicate (source of Si)
- For IWW and UTL recipes, x represents the molar fraction of GeO2 in the total (SiO2 + GeO2) content
